test_accounting: 4946 full default core unit tests + 177 selected core integration tests + 8 CLI tests. The discovery probe, its repeated 11 source tests, and the publication rerun of three ledger tests are excluded from unique totals.

implementation.phase: Ordinary static declarations finalize before deferred root source and Chebyshev specifications, then model folding. Sources and models see the same sampled parameter value.
implementation.grammar: Source specifications containing function calls are probed through the existing grammar with an isolated random counter, then evaluated live once on success. Function detection conservatively covers user functions and overloaded statistical functions without another builtin registry; literal and scalar-read paths avoid context snapshots.
implementation.deferral: Unresolved numeric identifiers are recognized from the grammar diagnostic, including explicit DC=DC bindings. Fallback expression classification uses an isolated random context. Optional DC/AC keyword boundaries retain their existing grammar.
implementation.origins: The parser records physical origins only for deferred root voltage/current specifications, then attaches that original owner to completion errors, including included sources.

independent_oracles: Root voltage/current sources using a forward value produce 1 V into a 1 ohm load; the complex IMG variant produces 0 V under the existing sqrt convention.

Seed-37 reference streams check eager parameter draws, one retained parameter sample shared with source/model values, source-card draw order and the untouched next draw. AUNIF, two-argument LIMIT, AGAUSS, lazy branches and user functions are included.
Forward PWL source values follow V(t)=2*min(t/1us,1) over a complete 2us transient.
A source with value=base^2 at base=2 has DC and AC-magnitude derivatives of 4 through public sensitivity APIs.
A grouped Xyce source using base+TIME remains dynamic and follows V(t)=1+t through a 10ms transient.
Independent subcircuit instances with base=1 and base=6 yield 2 V and 7 V, preserving local forward bindings.
